title: Surreal Cosmic Wanderer
description: A surreal figure with two pale faces walks through a dreamlike landscape. The main head has closed eyes and lavender stalks growing from it, while a backpack features a red planet with rings; the background blends starry space, swirling patterns, geometric fields, and floating faces.
prompt: Surreal artwork of a tall pale humanoid figure with two faces walking forward, the front face has closed eyes and multiple lavender flower stalks growing from the bald head, a second face emerges behind it, wearing a jacket with a backpack that displays a detailed red planet with rings like Saturn, set against a psychedelic background split between a black cosmic space with stars, constellations and floating stylized faces on the right, and swirling line patterns with purple and orange geometric fields of triangular and spiral motifs on the left, intricate linework, mystical atmosphere.
